result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred cap, mutuality, required uncapped carve-outs, and payment-obligation treatment. However, the opening “Except for Excluded Claims” appears to qualify both the cap and the consequential-damages exclusion, whereas the playbook specifies only that those claims be uncapped; it also adds exclusions for incidental, special, and punitive damages beyond the stated position. Drafting is further weakened by placing Section 9(c) after the Section 10 heading. The margin comment does not cure these issues.
